description: Sam Anderson at the University of British Columbia publishes municipal water-source information for Alberta, Canada, collected between September 2018 and September 2019. The deposit provides CSV and Excel versions plus a README, free under CC BY 4.0. Fields identify municipality name and status, specific supply source, source class, regional water commission and coordinates. A separate 'Via' location identifies water supplied through another community or treatment system. River classes distinguish glacier-fed sources from other rivers, alongside groundwater and lakes. These relationships can help connect municipal demand to shared source-water hazards or build a regional supply-dependency simulation. The inventory is a historical snapshot; pipe routes, capacities, current service arrangements and completeness remain unknown. No related catalogue record explicitly identifies this Alberta collection. The README was inspected, while the tabular files were not downloaded.
